summary: Describes a way to keep network topology private when paths are computed across several domains by cooperating PCEs. Hidden segments of a path are replaced by an encrypted path key, so operators need not reveal their internal layout.

eli5.summary: A delivery company may not want to show competitors its secret routes. This note replaces the secret part of a route with a locked token that only that company can open.

questions: what is a path key in pce
how to keep topology confidential in inter-domain path computation
